app.name: Geezy
app.long_description: Hold sideways. A: four-tick spatial stutter and voxel lock; release for 1.8x impulse. B: full-screen overdrive and eased inversion graphics. 1: palette. 2: box structure and motion style. D-pad: tap for directional impulse, hold for 5x boost. Plus/Minus: speed and density gear 0-3. Plus and Minus together: reset. Optional shake: 2.5x impulse. HOME: exit. No sensor bar required.
